archive.description: Actual live-CNS research chain: dynamics, temporal fit, browser export, paired physical-screen response, teacher curricula, and matched physical rollouts.

claims_not_established: general optic/body prediction improvement beyond the procedural fit split

curriculum_controller.autonomous_outcome: offline loss improvement with physical cost regression in the first matched world
curriculum_controller.map_three_world_outcome: mixed, with worse physiology and net food-stock-loss measures; no promotion

public_summary.status: executed research chain with mixed outcomes

fields.metric: heldout 0.2-second delta decoder skill against persistence

source.text: Across three new matched worlds, MAP selection increased stopping and proximity but had slightly worse mean reserve and fatigue changes, higher effort, and less net target food-stock loss than the initialized parent.

fields.diagnosis: The failed collector reused an options object mutated by the Emscripten factory; this was a caller/options-lifetime bug, not a MuJoCo singleton restriction.
fields.error: MuJoCo Emscripten singleton refused a second factory initialization: noExitRuntime was not exported
fields.resolution: LiveEngine now retains immutable Wasm bytes and passes a fresh {wasmBinary} object to every factory initialization; later independent initialization passed.
